name: Ore no Yome to Musume ga Hentai ni Torawareta
original_name: 俺の嫁と娘が変態に捕らわれた
source:
Takumi Kurosaki returned from a two-day trip to an empty house.
Until now he'd lived happily with Satomi, his loving wife, and their daughter Ayumi.
There was a photograph on the center table. Oh god...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ086577.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
黑崎拓海结束了两天的旅行，回到了空荡荡的房子。
迄今为止，他与深爱的妻子里美以及女儿步美幸福地生活在一起。
中间的桌子上有一张照片。天哪…

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ086577.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
